# Simple Shot Timer

> Simple Shot Timer is the free and open-source shot timer app, with no ads and no data tracking. It is available on Android, and on iOS soon. It turns a phone into a shot timer for dry-fire and live-fire practice: it detects shots through the microphone, shows splits live, runs Standard, Par and Stage drills, saves the drills you run often and keeps every string on the phone.

- The first and currently only free and open-source shot timer app.
- Price: free. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases, and no data tracking: the app sends nothing off the phone.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play, package `cc.jami.simpleshottimer`); iOS coming soon to the App Store.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French and Russian.
- License: GPL-3.0-only with additional attribution terms under section 7 (see NOTICE in the repository).
- Founder and maintainer: Tareq Jami of Jami IT (https://jami-it.de/en/), Hamburg, Germany.
- It is not meant to fully replace a dedicated shot timer: it is limited by phone hardware, and is a solid alternative to buying a $100+ timer or for when you left yours at home.
